title: Velocity Ambiguity Profiles: Time-Resolved Bayes-Risk Diagnostics for Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.30107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flow matching trains a continuum of velocity regression problems but usually reports a loss averaged over interpolation time, obscuring which regions are limited by intrinsic ambiguity and which remain data-limited. We introduce the Velocity Ambiguity Profile (VAP), $\mathcal{A}_v(t)$, the time-local Bayes-risk floor of velocity prediction, and decompose time-resolved loss as $L_N(t)=\mathcal{A}_v(t)+R(t;N)$, where only the excess term $R(t;N)$ is reducible by more data or a different estimator. For $N$ training samples and a $K$-component mixture in the structured example, we prove two statistical benchmarks. In an intrinsic local-regression benchmark, $\mathcal{A}_v(t)$ enters the time-dependent noise factor of the standard nonparametric rate. In separated isotropic Gaussian mixtures, the Bayes velocity becomes locally affine, and a label-oracle residual-regression benchmark has parametric excess-risk scale $K\mathcal{A}_v(t)/N$, match

translated_title: 速度模糊剖面：面向流匹配的时间分辨贝叶斯风险诊断
translated_abstract: 流匹配训练的是一系列连续的速度回归问题，但通常报告的是对插值时间取平均的损失，这掩盖了哪些区域受内在模糊性限制、哪些区域仍然受数据量限制。我们引入速度模糊剖面（VAP），即 $\mathcal{A}_v(t)$——速度预测在时间局部的贝叶斯风险下界，并将时间分辨的损失分解为 $L_N(t)=\mathcal{A}_v(t)+R(t;N)$，其中只有超额项 $R(t;N)$ 可以通过更多数据或不同的估计器来降低。对于 $N$ 个训练样本以及结构化示例中的 $K$ 分量混合分布，我们证明了两个统计基准。在一个内在的局部回归基准中，$\mathcal{A}_v(t)$ 进入标准非参数收敛率中随时间变化的噪声因子；在分离的各向同性高斯混合分布中，贝叶斯速度变为局部仿射的，且标签神谕（label-oracle）残差回归基准具有参数化的超额风险规模 $K\mathcal{A}_v(t)/N$，与……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出速度模糊剖面（VAP）这一新诊断工具，将流匹配的时间分辨损失分解为不可约的贝叶斯风险下界与可通过数据或改进估计器降低的超额项，并在两个结构化基准中证明了其统计收敛性质，从而揭示了流匹配在哪些时间区域受内在模糊性限制、哪些区域仍可由数据改进。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Velocity Ambiguity Profile (VAP), a time-resolved diagnostic that decomposes flow matching loss into an irreducible Bayes-risk floor and a reducible excess term, proving two statistical benchmarks that quantify where performance is limited by intrinsic ambiguity versus data availability.
